title: Premium Credits, Flat Charges and Minimums in the HomeFlood Rate Manual
content:
The credit percentages, flat annual charges and premium minimums for **HomeFlood Private Residential Flood Policies** are scheduled as follows.

| Tier | Mitigation credit (percent) | Claims-free credit (percent) | Claims-free period (years back from the term start) | Package credit (percent) | Ceiling on all credits combined (percent) | Loss-of-use charge (USD per year) | Minimum annual premium (USD) | Policy fee (USD per year) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| HomeFlood Renters | 10 | 5 | 3 | 5 | 15 | 25 | 125 | 35 |
| HomeFlood Essential | 10 | 5 | 3 | 5 | 15 | 0 | 350 | 35 |
| HomeFlood Standard | 10 | 5 | 3 | 5 | 15 | 45 | 450 | 35 |
| HomeFlood Plus | 10 | 5 | 3 | 5 | 15 | 95 | 650 | 35 |
| HomeFlood Premier | 10 | 5 | 3 | 5 | 15 | 160 | 950 | 35 |
| HomeFlood Estate | 10 | 5 | 3 | 5 | 15 | 290 | 1750 | 35 |

## What each figure is

- **Mitigation credit** — the credit when the Elevation Certificate certifies engineered flood openings in the enclosure or foundation.
- **Claims-free credit** and **claims-free period** — the credit when no paid claim has a date of loss within the period, the period being counted back from the term start.
- **Package credit** — the credit when the customer holds an active Tidemark Excess Flood policy on the same property.
- **Ceiling on all credits combined** — the most that the credits applied to one term may total.
- **Loss-of-use charge** — the flat annual charge for the loss-of-use coverage; HomeFlood Essential, which provides no loss of use, charges 0.
- **Minimum annual premium** — the lowest annual premium after factors and credits, before the policy fee.
- **Policy fee** — the annual policy fee, fully earned when the term starts.

*Hypothetical illustration:* on a HomeFlood Standard term where the credit percentages that apply total 20 percent, the ceiling holds the credit applied to that term at 15 percent.
